svg.title: Photosynthesis
svg.desc: Photosynthesis. Sunlight → Chloroplast in the leaf. Water (H2O) → Chloroplast in the leaf: roots. Carbon dioxide (CO2) → Chloroplast in the leaf: air. Chloroplast in the leaf → Glucose: food. Chloroplast in the leaf → Oxygen (O2): breathed out. Note on Glucose: plants store it as starch.
